verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Experiment Management API for creating and controlling flags and experiments, with dedicated Holdout and Mutex APIs, and explicitly supports managing flags and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools. A probe also found a published OpenAPI spec at amplitude.com/openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Experiment through the API, and confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers the Experiment endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
Use the Experiment management API to programmatically create and control flags and experiments.
Holdout APIs to create, edit, and display holdout groups and their properties.
Mutex APIs to create, edit, and display mutex groups and their properties.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://amplitude.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
